$comment: Shipped defaults. Override any of these in ~/.config/wordtap/config.json (only the keys you change). sources: which dictionaries to show, top to bottom; ids match providers/<id>.json. ocrLanguages: Tesseract languages that read the word under the pointer, "auto" for every installed pack (at most four) or a list like ["eng", "fra"]. tap: the touchpad gesture that looks up the word under the pointer.
